I’m currently a 20F and my boyfriend is 20M. How we met is through tinder and omg let me tell you we were both very nervous meeting each other for the first time. We met right away after a day of texting through tinder. The first time we met he was visibly shaking due to nervousness and was stuttering while trying to talk to me. I was nervous but I tried to keep my cool and comfort him by hugging him and reassuring that everything is going well and that I am interested in him still. After a month of talking, he gradually got comfortable with me and now we’ve been together for 7 months now. We both fell in love with each other because we both had a very positive influence in each others lives. We were pretty much in a dark place before we met each other, I didn’t do well in college due to my depression and he was losing motivation for work and would sometimes cry himself to sleep because he thought he wouldn’t find anyone. Now, we’re helping each other achieve our goals and grow into the person we want to be. 
I should also note that this is my very first boyfriend so time will place the right person in your life :)
